source: latestpyqs Shreshta APPSC Group-1 & 2 Prelims & Mains PYQs (b3p2) p12
s:
Who from the following were associated with Subhash Chandra Bose's Indian National Army and faced the trial in Delhi in 1945?
(a) P.K. Sahgal
(b) G.S. Dhillon
(c) Shah Nawaz Khan
(d) Bhulabhai Desai
x: INA officers P.K. Sahgal, G.S. Dhillon and Shah Nawaz Khan were tried by the British in the Red Fort Trials (1945-46). The trials generated widespread nationalist support across India.

source: latestpyqs Shreshta APPSC Group-1 & 2 Prelims & Mains PYQs (b3p2) p12
s: Whose book 'Unto this Last' left a deep impact on Mahatma Gandhi and he even translated it into Gujarati?
x: 'Unto This Last' by John Ruskin greatly influenced Gandhi, who translated it into Gujarati as 'Sarvodaya'.

source: latestpyqs Shreshta APPSC Group-1 & 2 Prelims & Mains PYQs (b3p2) p12
s:
Which of the following movements are related to caste-consciousness, leading to caste-movements in particular regions?
(a) Satyashodhak Samaj in Maharashtra
(b) Self-respect agitation in Tamilnadu
(c) Ghadar movement in Punjab
(d) Bijolia movement in Rajasthan
x: The Satyashodhak Samaj of Jyotirao Phule in Maharashtra and the Self-Respect Movement of Periyar in Tamil Nadu were movements against caste oppression.

source: latestpyqs Shreshta APPSC Group-1 & 2 Prelims & Mains PYQs (b3p2) p12
s: Choose the correct answer relating to the Supreme Court of India.
o: The Supreme Court can strike down any law passed by Parliament
The Supreme Court has the autonomy to make rules for the practice and procedure of court
The Supreme Court can issue ordinances
The Supreme Court advises the President on all matters
x: The Supreme Court frames its own rules of practice and procedure under Article 145. It cannot issue ordinances and its advisory role is limited to references under Article 143.

source: latestpyqs Shreshta APPSC Group-1 & 2 Prelims & Mains PYQs (b3p2) p12
s: The Objectives specified in the Preamble contain the basic structure of our Constitution. In this regard, choose the correct answer.
o: Basic structure means that which can be amended with a simple majority
Basic structure means that which cannot be amended in exercise of the power under Article 368 of the Constitution
Basic structure refers to the Directive Principles only
Basic structure refers to Fundamental Rights only
x: Under the Basic Structure Doctrine (Kesavananda Bharati, 1973), Parliament's amending power under Article 368 cannot destroy the Constitution's basic structure.

source: latestpyqs Shreshta APPSC Group-1 & 2 Prelims & Mains PYQs (b3p2) p12
s: Estimates Committee is related to which reform to ensure efficiency?
x: The Estimates Committee is a financial committee that examines government expenditure and suggests economies, making it an instrument of financial control.

source: latestpyqs Shreshta APPSC Group-1 & 2 Prelims & Mains PYQs (b3p2) p12
s: Most important components of secularism are mentioned below, EXCEPT —
o: Equal treatment of all religions by the State
x: Secularism applies to all citizens, including those who follow no religion, so the statement that it is not applicable to irreligious persons is incorrect.

source: latestpyqs Shreshta APPSC Group-1 & 2 Prelims & Mains PYQs (b3p2) p12
s: Social justice enables the Courts to uphold legislation, EXCEPT —
o: Laws protecting weaker sections of society
To enact unquestionable laws to protect certain people of the society
x: Social justice allows courts to uphold protective laws such as reservations and welfare measures, but not laws that are unquestionable or beyond judicial review.

source: latestpyqs Shreshta APPSC Group-1 & 2 Prelims & Mains PYQs (b3p2) p12
s: A person whose freedom of movement has been taken away by imprisonment or detention does not thereby lose his freedom of —
x: A detained person does not lose all fundamental rights; rights like freedom of expression may still be exercised within reasonable limits.

source: latestpyqs Shreshta APPSC Group-1 & 2 Prelims & Mains PYQs (b3p2) p12
s: Regarding the Habeas Corpus, choose the WRONG answer.
o: It is a writ for personal liberty
A petition of Habeas Corpus lies against the executive authority, not available against private individuals
It can be issued by the Supreme Court and High Courts
It orders production of the detained person before the court
x: Habeas Corpus can be issued not only against government authorities but also against private individuals who illegally detain someone.

source: latestpyqs Shreshta APPSC Group-1 & 2 Prelims & Mains PYQs (b3p2) p12
s: Regarding the Directive Principle of State Policy, choose the WRONG answer.
o: Parliament cannot amend Fundamental Rights for implementing the Directive Principles
They promote welfare of the people
x: Parliament may amend Fundamental Rights to implement Directive Principles, provided the amendments do not violate the basic structure.

source: latestpyqs Shreshta APPSC Group-1 & 2 Prelims & Mains PYQs (b3p2) p13
s: Regarding the Governor, all the following statements are correct, EXCEPT —
o: The Governor is appointed by the President
The Governor acts as the constitutional head of the state
Governor shall quit his office immediately after expiry of his term
The Governor can reserve a Bill for the consideration of the President
x: The Governor's term is normally five years, but he continues in office until his successor assumes office.

source: latestpyqs Shreshta APPSC Group-1 & 2 Prelims & Mains PYQs (b3p2) p13
s: The orders passed by the Governor of a State (Article 163) fall in four categories. Find out the category which is NOT subject to Judicial Review.
o: Where the Governor acts on the aid and advice of the Council of Ministers
Where the Governor acts without the aid and advice of the Council of Ministers and acts in his own discretion
Where the Governor acts in legislative matters
Where the Governor addresses the legislature
x: Article 163 allows the Governor to act in his discretion in certain situations, and such purely discretionary decisions are generally not subject to judicial review.

source: latestpyqs Shreshta APPSC Group-1 & 2 Prelims & Mains PYQs (b3p2) p13
s: Regarding the Union Council of Ministers, choose the WRONG answer.
o: The Council of Ministers is collectively responsible to the Lok Sabha
The Prime Minister is the head of the Council of Ministers
During the period of National Emergency, the President acquires discretionary powers, and can take independent decisions
A Minister who is not a member of Parliament for six months ceases to be a minister
x: The President normally acts on the advice of the Council of Ministers even during emergencies, so the claim that he acquires independent discretionary powers during a National Emergency is incorrect.

source: latestpyqs Shreshta APPSC Group-1 & 2 Prelims & Mains PYQs (b3p2) p13
s: The Preamble may be invoked to determine the ambit of —
x: The Preamble is an interpretative aid; courts refer to it to determine the scope and spirit of both Fundamental Rights and Directive Principles.

source: latestpyqs Shreshta APPSC Group-1 & 2 Prelims & Mains PYQs (b3p2) p13
s: Which of the following are NOT the federal features of the Indian Constitution?
x: Dual government, a written constitution and an independent judiciary are federal features; the office of the Governor is not.

source: latestpyqs Shreshta APPSC Group-1 & 2 Prelims & Mains PYQs (b3p2) p13
s: What option does the government exercise and legislators have when they do not like a decision made by the Supreme Court?
o: Pass a constitutional amendment that circumvents the decision only
Pass a law challenging the decision only
Both are options — pass a constitutional amendment that circumvents the decision or pass a law challenging the decision
x: If the legislature disagrees with a Supreme Court judgment, it may pass a new law addressing the court's concerns or amend the Constitution to overcome it.

source: latestpyqs Shreshta APPSC Group-1 & 2 Prelims & Mains PYQs (b3p2) p13
s: Regarding the disagreement between the two Houses of the State Legislature, which of the following is correct?
o: The Council can permanently block a bill
The only power of the Council is to interpose some delay in the passage of the bill
A joint session is convened to resolve the dispute
The Governor has the final say
x: The Legislative Council cannot permanently block a bill; it can only delay its passage for a limited period.

source: latestpyqs Shreshta APPSC Group-1 & 2 Prelims & Mains PYQs (b3p2) p13
s: Choose the correct answer from the following.
o: A member of an All India Service is under the exclusive control of the State Government
A member of an All India Service can be dismissed or removed only by the Union government
A member of an All India Service cannot be transferred to another state
A member of an All India Service is appointed by the State Public Service Commission
x: All India Service officers are appointed by the Union Government and serve both Union and States; their dismissal or removal can only be done by the Union Government.

source: latestpyqs Shreshta APPSC Group-1 & 2 Prelims & Mains PYQs (b3p2) p13
s: Regarding the powers of the President, which of the following is correct?
o: The President can dismiss any judge of a High Court
Courts are debarred from invalidating any legislation on the ground that the President's previous sanction was not obtained
The President can override the decisions of the Council of Ministers
The President can call a referendum on any issue
x: Courts cannot invalidate a law merely because the President's prior sanction was not obtained if it has already been enacted; absence of sanction is a procedural irregularity.

source: latestpyqs Shreshta APPSC Group-1 & 2 Prelims & Mains PYQs (b3p2) p13
s:
Match the following:
List I:
(a) Reprieve
(b) Respite
(c) Remission
(d) Commutation
List II:
I. Reduce the amount of sentence without changing its character
II. Substitute one form of punishment for other of a lighter character
III. Awarding lesser sentence
IV. A stay of execution of sentence

source: latestpyqs Shreshta APPSC Group-1 & 2 Prelims & Mains PYQs (b3p2) p14
s: Regarding the pardoning powers, choose the correct answer.
o: Both the President and Governor can pardon a death sentence
The only authority for pardoning a sentence of death is the President
The Supreme Court can pardon a death sentence
The Governor can pardon a death sentence in his state
x: The President can pardon death sentences under Article 72. Governors can grant pardons for offences under state law but cannot pardon a death sentence.

source: latestpyqs Shreshta APPSC Group-1 & 2 Prelims & Mains PYQs (b3p2) p14
s: A sitting of the Parliament can be terminated by adjournment, prorogation or dissolution. In this regard choose the correct answer.
o: Prorogation terminates the session of Parliament
Adjournment sine die means terminating a sitting for an indefinite period
x: Adjournment temporarily suspends a sitting, while adjournment sine die ends the sitting for an indefinite period. Prorogation, ordered by the President, ends a session.

source: latestpyqs Shreshta APPSC Group-1 & 2 Prelims & Mains PYQs (b3p2) p14
s: Which of the following Liberties is sought to be secured to the citizens of India in the Preamble?
o: Thought, expression, belief, faith and worship
x: The Preamble secures to citizens liberty of thought, expression, belief, faith and worship.

source: latestpyqs Shreshta APPSC Group-1 & 2 Prelims & Mains PYQs (b3p2) p14
s: Recommendations for the 14th Finance Commission are valid from —
x: The 14th Finance Commission's recommendations applied from 1 April 2015 to 31 March 2020. It raised the states' share in central taxes to 42%.

source: latestpyqs Shreshta APPSC Group-1 & 2 Prelims & Mains PYQs (b3p2) p14
s: Which of the following bodies concerned with Inter-State relations are Constitutional?
x: The Inter-State Council is a constitutional body under Article 263 that promotes Centre-State coordination.

source: latestpyqs Shreshta APPSC Group-1 & 2 Prelims & Mains PYQs (b3p2) p14
s: M.M. Punchhi Committee was appointed to study Centre-State relations. Regarding Punchhi recommendations all the following statements are correct EXCEPT —
o: Governor should be a person from outside the state
National Integration Commission shall meet once in two years
Council of Ministers should have a say in appointment of the Governor
x: The Punchhi Commission (2007) recommended Centre-State reforms, but the suggestion that the National Integration Council should meet once every two years was not one of them.

source: latestpyqs Shreshta APPSC Group-1 & 2 Prelims & Mains PYQs (b3p2) p14
s: Regarding the composition of the Legislative Council, all the following statements are correct, EXCEPT —
o: 1/3rd of the total members shall be elected by members of local bodies
1/13th of the total number of Council shall be elected by Legislative Assembly
1/6th shall be nominated by the Governor
x: Under Article 171, 1/3 of Council members are elected by local bodies, 1/12 by graduates, 1/12 by teachers, 1/3 by MLAs and 1/6 nominated by the Governor.

source: latestpyqs Shreshta APPSC Group-1 & 2 Prelims & Mains PYQs (b3p2) p14
s: The President may appoint a Governor of a State as the administrator of an adjoining Union Territory. Such Governor in the administration of the Union Territory shall exercise his functions —
o: With the aid and advice of the Council of Ministers of the State
As such administrator independently of his Council of Ministers
Under the direct supervision of the President
With the help of a council appointed by the Union Territory
x: A Governor appointed administrator of a Union Territory acts independently, without the aid and advice of the State Council of Ministers.

source: latestpyqs Shreshta APPSC Group-1 & 2 Prelims & Mains PYQs (b3p2) p14
s: Parliament has the power to enact laws with respect to a matter in the State list in the national interest. In this regard choose the WRONG answer.
o: Parliament can legislate on State List subjects during National Emergency
Both Union and State governments have absolute freedom to make laws related to Concurrent list
Rajya Sabha can pass a resolution empowering Parliament to legislate on a State List subject
Parliament can legislate on State List subjects if two or more states pass a resolution
x: Union and State powers on Concurrent List subjects are not absolute; in case of conflict the central law prevails.

source: latestpyqs Shreshta APPSC Group-1 & 2 Prelims & Mains PYQs (b3p2) p15
s: State Government can pass a law imposing restrictions on goods imported from other States. Such law shall be moved in the Legislature of a State without the previous sanction of the —
x: Under Article 304(b), a state law restricting goods from other states requires the prior sanction of the President before introduction in the state legislature.

source: latestpyqs Shreshta APPSC Group-1 & 2 Prelims & Mains PYQs (b3p2) p15
s: 'Sustainable Development is the development that meets the needs of the present without compromising on the ability of future generations to meet their own needs.' Who has given this definition?
x: This definition was given in the Brundtland Report 'Our Common Future' (1987) of the World Commission on Environment and Development.

source: latestpyqs Shreshta APPSC Group-1 & 2 Prelims & Mains PYQs (b3p2) p15
s: Out of the options given below, what should be the basic goal of 'Sustainable Development'?
x: The central objective of sustainable development is equitable and inclusive growth while preserving environmental resources.

source: latestpyqs Shreshta APPSC Group-1 & 2 Prelims & Mains PYQs (b3p2) p15
s: Which is the curve that explains the relationship between economic growth and environmental degradation?
x: The Environmental Kuznets Curve shows degradation rising in early stages of growth and declining after a certain income level.

source: latestpyqs Shreshta APPSC Group-1 & 2 Prelims & Mains PYQs (b3p2) p15
s: According to 2010 Human Development Index calculated (Compiled and Computed from UNDP Human Development Report) for 169 countries, what is the rank of India?
x: In the UNDP Human Development Report 2010, India ranked 119th among 169 countries.

source: latestpyqs Shreshta APPSC Group-1 & 2 Prelims & Mains PYQs (b3p2) p15
s: What is the approach followed by National Institution for Transforming India (NITI) Aayog in the economic policy making?
x: NITI Aayog, set up in 2015 to replace the Planning Commission, promotes co-operative federalism between the Union and the States.

source: latestpyqs Shreshta APPSC Group-1 & 2 Prelims & Mains PYQs (b3p2) p15
s: Though removal of unemployment is mentioned as one of the objectives of economic planning in all Five Year Plans, from which plan onward is serious concern shown for solving the unemployment problem?
x: Serious attention to unemployment began in the Fifth Five Year Plan (1974-79), with several employment-oriented programmes.

source: latestpyqs Shreshta APPSC Group-1 & 2 Prelims & Mains PYQs (b3p2) p15
s: Which of the following statements is INCORRECT?
o: India is the second largest producer of rice in the world
About 60% of agricultural lands have irrigational facilities
Green Revolution mainly benefited wheat and rice cultivation
x: The claim that about 60% of agricultural land is irrigated is incorrect; a large part of Indian agriculture still depends on rainfall.

source: latestpyqs Shreshta APPSC Group-1 & 2 Prelims & Mains PYQs (b3p2) p15
s: To enhance food security and to make Indian Agriculture more resilient to climate change, which programme was started in 2011-12?
x: The National Mission for Sustainable Agriculture (2011-12), under the National Action Plan on Climate Change, aims to make agriculture climate-resilient.

source: latestpyqs Shreshta APPSC Group-1 & 2 Prelims & Mains PYQs (b3p2) p15
s: Which sector comprises water supply?
x: Water supply and utilities are classified under the secondary sector, linked to the industrial sector.

source: latestpyqs Shreshta APPSC Group-1 & 2 Prelims & Mains PYQs (b3p2) p15
s: What is the main objective of the 12th Five Year Plan?
x: The Twelfth Five Year Plan (2012-17) adopted the theme 'Faster, Sustainable and More Inclusive Growth'.

source: latestpyqs Shreshta APPSC Group-1 & 2 Prelims & Mains PYQs (b3p2) p16
s: Among the following National Income Concepts, find out the correct one.
o: GDP at Market Price = GNP at Market Price + Net Income from Abroad
GDP at Market Price = GNP at Market Price − Net Income from Abroad
GNP at Market Price = GDP at Market Price + Net Income from Abroad
NNP = GNP − Depreciation + Net Income from Abroad
x: In national income accounting, GDP at Market Price = GNP at Market Price minus Net Income from Abroad.

source: latestpyqs Shreshta APPSC Group-1 & 2 Prelims & Mains PYQs (b3p2) p16
s: What is the method used to calculate chronic unemployment?
x: Usual Status measures unemployment over a long reference period (usually one year) and is used to estimate chronic unemployment.

source: latestpyqs Shreshta APPSC Group-1 & 2 Prelims & Mains PYQs (b3p2) p16
s: In India, in which year was the 'Special Economic Zone' policy announced?
x: India's SEZ policy was announced in 2000 and strengthened by the SEZ Act 2005, which came into effect in 2006.

source: latestpyqs Shreshta APPSC Group-1 & 2 Prelims & Mains PYQs (b3p2) p16
s: According to United Nations' Millennium Development Goals Programme (2011-2012), what is the percentage of population below the poverty line in India?
x: According to the MDG report (2011-12), about 21.9% of India's population lived below the poverty line.

source: latestpyqs Shreshta APPSC Group-1 & 2 Prelims & Mains PYQs (b3p2) p16
s: At present, with which name is Swarnajayanti Gram Swarozgar Yojana (1999) implemented?
x: SGSY was restructured and implemented as Aajeevika (National Rural Livelihood Mission).

source: latestpyqs Shreshta APPSC Group-1 & 2 Prelims & Mains PYQs (b3p2) p16
s: What is the basic goal of 'Mission Indradhanush' launched in 2014 by the Central Government?
x: Mission Indradhanush (2014) aims to improve immunization coverage for children and pregnant women.

source: latestpyqs Shreshta APPSC Group-1 & 2 Prelims & Mains PYQs (b3p2) p16
s: In relation to Andhra Pradesh, which of the following applications has received CSI Nihilent Best e-Governance Award during the year 2017-18?
x: AP's D-Krishi application, which gives digital agricultural advisory services to farmers, won the CSI Nihilent Best e-Governance Award (2017-18).

source: latestpyqs Shreshta APPSC Group-1 & 2 Prelims & Mains PYQs (b3p2) p16
s: Which organization launched Rupay card?
x: RuPay was developed by the National Payments Corporation of India (NPCI) as India's domestic card payment network.

source: latestpyqs Shreshta APPSC Group-1 & 2 Prelims & Mains PYQs (b3p2) p16
s: Which is the program that has the theme 'One Nation – One Scheme'?
x: The Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana introduced 'One Nation – One Scheme' for crop insurance.

source: latestpyqs Shreshta APPSC Group-1 & 2 Prelims & Mains PYQs (b3p2) p16
s: What is the maturity period of treasury bills issued by Government of India?
x: The Government of India issues Treasury Bills with maturities of 91, 182 and 364 days.

source: latestpyqs Shreshta APPSC Group-1 & 2 Prelims & Mains PYQs (b3p2) p16
s: Which of the following statements is NOT correct regarding Basel III implementation in India?
o: It requires higher capital adequacy ratios
It was introduced to strengthen banking regulation
Minimum Tier 1 capital ratio should be 8%
It focuses on systemic risk management
x: Basel III requires higher capital adequacy and better risk management, but the statement that minimum Tier-1 capital ratio should be 8% is incorrect for its implementation in India.

source: latestpyqs Shreshta APPSC Group-1 & 2 Prelims & Mains PYQs (b3p2) p16
s: Which of the following in general is eligible as a borrower under National Rural Livelihood Mission (NRLM)?
x: Under NRLM the primary beneficiaries are women self-help groups.

source: latestpyqs Shreshta APPSC Group-1 & 2 Prelims & Mains PYQs (b3p2) p16
s: What is the objective of National Credit Fund for Women, launched by Government of India in the year 1993?
o: To provide housing loans to women
To meet the asset needs of poor and assetless women in the informal sector
To fund women entrepreneurs in formal sector
To provide scholarships to girl students
x: The National Credit Fund for Women (Rashtriya Mahila Kosh, 1993) provides microcredit to support income-generating activities of asset-less women in the informal sector.

source: latestpyqs Shreshta APPSC Group-1 & 2 Prelims & Mains PYQs (b3p2) p17
s: According to the 2014 Reorganization Act, after the bifurcation of the State, how many revenue divisions are there in Andhra Pradesh?
x: After the AP Reorganisation Act 2014, residual Andhra Pradesh had 50 revenue divisions.

source: latestpyqs Shreshta APPSC Group-1 & 2 Prelims & Mains PYQs (b3p2) p17
s: After bifurcation, according to the suggestions of NITI Aayog, who has to take the construction responsibility of Polavaram Project?
x: Construction of the Polavaram Project was entrusted to the Government of Andhra Pradesh, with financial support from the Centre.

source: latestpyqs Shreshta APPSC Group-1 & 2 Prelims & Mains PYQs (b3p2) p17
s: Recently announced South Coastal Railway zone comprises of —
x: The South Coast Railway Zone, announced in 2019, includes the Guntakal, Guntur and Vijayawada divisions, with headquarters at Visakhapatnam.

source: latestpyqs Shreshta APPSC Group-1 & 2 Prelims & Mains PYQs (b3p2) p17
s: What is the name of the project launched with the objective of computerization of Urban Local bodies?
x: The e-Suvidha project was launched for computerization and online citizen services in Urban Local Bodies.

source: latestpyqs Shreshta APPSC Group-1 & 2 Prelims & Mains PYQs (b3p2) p17
s: Which district in Andhra Pradesh has the largest area under food crops?
x: West Godavari has the largest area under food crops in Andhra Pradesh, especially rice.

source: latestpyqs Shreshta APPSC Group-1 & 2 Prelims & Mains PYQs (b3p2) p17
s:
Match the following List I with List II (Northern Hemisphere):
List I:
(a) Winter solstice
(b) Summer solstice
(c) Vernal equinox
(d) Autumnal equinox
List II:
I. December 22
II. June 21
III. March 21
IV. September 23

source: latestpyqs Shreshta APPSC Group-1 & 2 Prelims & Mains PYQs (b3p2) p17
s: The boundary between crust and mantle is ________ discontinuity.
x: The Mohorovicic Discontinuity (Moho) separates the crust from the mantle; it was discovered by Andrija Mohorovicic in 1909.

source: latestpyqs Shreshta APPSC Group-1 & 2 Prelims & Mains PYQs (b3p2) p17
s: The bottom topography of an ocean can be shown by —
x: The hypsometric curve shows the distribution of elevations and depths of land and ocean surfaces, depicting ocean floor topography.

source: latestpyqs Shreshta APPSC Group-1 & 2 Prelims & Mains PYQs (b3p2) p17
s: Yellowstone National Park, which is famous for geysers/hot springs, is located in —
x: Yellowstone National Park, famous for geysers, is in the United States, mainly in Wyoming, and was established in 1872.

source: latestpyqs Shreshta APPSC Group-1 & 2 Prelims & Mains PYQs (b3p2) p17
s: Which one among the following is a Volcanic Mountain?
x: Mount Etna in Sicily (Italy) is one of the most active volcanoes; Everest and Mont Blanc are fold mountains.

source: latestpyqs Shreshta APPSC Group-1 & 2 Prelims & Mains PYQs (b3p2) p17
s: Which one of the following lakes is NOT part of the Great Lakes of North America?
x: The Great Lakes are Superior, Michigan, Huron, Erie and Ontario; Lake Victoria is in East Africa.

source: latestpyqs Shreshta APPSC Group-1 & 2 Prelims & Mains PYQs (b3p2) p17
s:
Consider the following two statements and choose the appropriate answer:
A. Gorges and Canyons represent V-shaped valleys.
B. Gorges are the extended forms of Canyons.
o: Both A and B are correct
Neither A nor B is correct
x: Gorges and canyons are both deep, narrow, steep-sided valleys formed by river erosion, but canyons are wider and more extensive, so gorges are not extended forms of canyons.

source: latestpyqs Shreshta APPSC Group-1 & 2 Prelims & Mains PYQs (b3p2) p17
s: Arrange the following constituents (in terms of their quantity) in the atmosphere in descending order.
x: In descending order: Nitrogen (~78%), Oxygen (~21%), Argon (~0.93%) and Carbon dioxide (~0.04%).

source: latestpyqs Shreshta APPSC Group-1 & 2 Prelims & Mains PYQs (b3p2) p17
s:
Which of the following statements rightly explain about Tropopause?
(i) Seasonal variation occurs in the height of tropopause.
(ii) It is the transition zone between troposphere and stratosphere.
(iii) It lies below the stratosphere.
o: Statements i, ii & iii are correct
x: The tropopause is the boundary between the troposphere and stratosphere, lying just below the stratosphere where temperature stops decreasing with altitude.
